scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları) — Government Scholarship Programme of the Presidency of Turks Abroad and Related Communities
scholarships.official_source: Türkiye Scholarships — Presidency of Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB), Republic of Türkiye

existing.funding_period: per month (stipend) plus one-off flight ticket
existing.description: Türkiye Scholarships is a government-funded, competitive scholarship programme run under the coordination of the Presidency of Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB) that places international scholarship holders in Turkish universities. The official 2026 announcement states it is open to citizens of all countries and to applicants seeking associate, bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees, with applications received in a single annual period from 10 January to 20 February. The programme funds tuition fees, a monthly stipend, health insurance, accommodation, a one-off flight ticket and a Turkish language course, and includes university and department placement. Short-term Research Scholarships and Success Scholarships are separate sub-programmes with their own application periods announced on the same official site.
eligibility: Graduates, or those due to graduate before August of the application year
Not a Turkish citizen or a person who has lost Turkish citizenship
Not already enrolled in a programme at a Turkish university at the level applied for
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizens of all countries are eligible. Turkish citizens and former Turkish citizens are excluded, as are applicants already enrolled at a Turkish university at the level for which they apply. Merit Scholarship candidates additionally need very high school leaving examination, language and academic qualification scores; Research Scholarships require researchers and academics.
benefits: Monthly stipend paid throughout the study period
Full tuition fee coverage at the host public university
Health insurance provided by the programme
Free academic, social and cultural programmes
University and department placement arranged by YTB
existing.english_requirement: Not required for the general scholarship. Proof of language proficiency (for example TOEFL IBT 80/120 or IELTS 6.5/9.0) is required only for the Merit Scholarship Programme, which also requires a minimum weighted average of 90% and a top-10 national examination rank.
application_method: Online application through the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS), free of charge
Register, upload the required documents and submit through the TBBS portal
existing.selection_notes: Competitive and merit-based, with a strong emphasis on candidates' academic excellence. Assessment involves a documentary evaluation process followed by an interview period; results are announced in early August for the general round.
existing.notes: Programme is fully funded but admission is separate from funding: candidates apply for the scholarship through TBBS and YTB assigns the university and department. Turkish language study is compulsory in year one.
existing.duration: Full-time degree programmes (associate, bachelor's, master's, doctoral)
existing.application_period: One annual period, 10 January – 20 February, for all degree levels; Research Scholarships and Success Scholarships run on separate periods
existing.deadline_display: Applications 10 January – 20 February each year (2026 cycle: 10 January – 20 February 2026)
